title: Plan: default-off CPU batch microprobe before runtime rewrite
source_head_before_experiment: current docs-plan head after this artifact is committed

candidate.goal: measure whether exact MXFP4 x Q8_0 batched CPU execution can approach 100+ GiB/s on hot expert data without changing logits
candidate.implementation_rule: If implemented, keep it default-off and isolated from accepted runtime; no performance SOTA benchmark until fixed-text top1 passes.

required_before_code: Inspect x86 MXFP4 kernel nrows support and whether batching multiple rows/experts can preserve the exact accumulation order already proven by CPU fallback.
Define a bounded microprobe that times hot data only and reports effective GiB/s, us/call, and max_abs/mean_abs against the current CPU fallback for sampled experts.
Reject if the probe cannot plausibly reach at least 90.6 GiB/s with less than 500 ms total integration overhead.

runtime_constraints_if_later_benchmarked.correctness: fixed-text llama-results top1 equality and coherent France output
runtime_constraints_if_later_benchmarked.promotion: commit/push/reproduce immediately if a compliant >4.4 tok/s result appears
